name: Judson Independent School District
districtFact: Judson ISD publishes academic calendar PDFs with the first day of school, last day of school, student and staff holidays, staff development days, teacher prep days, early release times, grading periods, bad weather make-up dates, and a separate Judson Early College Academy calendar when applicable.

about.title: About Judson ISD
about.content: Judson Independent School District serves families in the Live Oak and northeast San Antonio area of Bexar County. The district academic calendar is the main planning source for first day and last day dates, grading periods, student holidays, staff development days, teacher prep days, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, bad weather make-up dates, and early release schedules.

about.title: How to Use This Judson ISD Calendar
about.content: Use this page for districtwide Judson ISD calendar planning, then confirm campus events, testing windows, athletics, graduation information, weather closures, and same-day announcements through Judson ISD or your student's campus. Students at Judson Early College Academy may need to check the separate JECA calendar when one is published.

customSections.label: Judson ISD Local Calendar Context
customSections.content: Judson ISD calendar planning is especially useful for families comparing northeast San Antonio and Bexar County school schedules. Families should pay attention to early release days, teacher prep days, staff development days, bad weather make-up dates, and the separate Judson Early College Academy calendar before treating any date as final for childcare, travel, or work planning.

planningTips.title: Judson ISD Calendar Usage Tips
content: Use the official academic calendar PDF for districtwide student holidays, breaks, grading periods, early release days, and school start and end dates.
Check the Judson Early College Academy calendar separately if your student follows that program schedule.
Treat bad weather make-up dates as conditional planning dates until Judson ISD confirms whether they will be used.
Use the PDF for official review and the ICS file for a one-time personal calendar import.

comparisonTitle: Judson ISD Compared With Nearby Texas Districts
compareIntro: Use this nearby-district reference to compare Judson ISD with other San Antonio-area calendar pages currently available on MySchoolDates. Dates shown include the first day, last day, and spring break.

districtFaqs.q: Does Judson ISD publish a separate Early College Academy calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. For 2026-2027, Judson ISD lists a separate Judson Early College Academy calendar in addition to the district academic calendar.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Judson ISD calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Judson ISD calendars page and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Judson ISD.
